name: Ultra Instinct stacks from direct ability critical strikes (#1052)
contract: Ultra Instinct 704654's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Ultra Instinct 504166, which is entirely native: aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (BasePoints 2), aura 163 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (MiscValue 127) and SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION with MiscValue 504166, StackAmount 10. Spell.dbc gives 704654 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the aura never fired. The tooltip is 'Direct ability critical strikes now increase your ... critical strike chance and critical damage by $504166s1% ... stacking up to $504166u times' at ProcChance 100, so each guaranteed critical Bloodbolt must add exactly one stack. Bloodbolt rank 578305 is the rank a level-80 character owns. Crit Test Buff 503747 (aura 290, +100 percentage points) makes every strike critical, so nothing here depends on a proc roll.
